page_title: LIL 1-1 MAR | Lille v Marseille 04/05/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' Nothing more will happen in this game as the referee blows for full time.
90+4' Pierre-Emile Hojbjerg (Marseille) stands over the free kick and opts to take it himself, sending the ball towards the bottom right corner only for Lucas Chevalier to dive and make a save.
90+3' Gabriel Gudmundsson (Lille) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Eric Wattellier blows his whistle for a foul. Marseille are awarded a free kick from a dangerous position.
90+3' Jonathan Rowe (Marseille) gets to the rebound just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by one of the defending players.
90+3' The resulting set piece from Marseille is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.

90+1' Adrien Rabiot (Marseille) is first to latch onto the rebound inside the penalty area. He sends a promising shot towards the bottom right corner, but it is denied by the goalkeeper who pulls off a superb save.
90' The fourth official shows 3 min. of added time.
90' Roberto De Zerbi has decided to substitute Luis Henrique and he is replaced by Jonathan Rowe (Marseille).
88' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Marseille.
85' A substitution has been made. Ulisses Garcia goes off and Quentin Merlin (Marseille) comes on.
84' The current number of shots on goal is 1:4.
81' The cross fools the defence and leaves Leonardo Balerdi (Marseille) with an easy chance inside the box, but he mistimes his shot and sends it just wide of the left post.
79' Eric Wattellier shows the yellow card to Alexsandro (Lille) for a heavy challenge.
78' An accurate pass to the edge of the box is well taken by Jonathan David (Lille), whose instinctive shot towards goal flashes inches over the top.
74' 1 - 1 Goal! Geronimo Rulli makes a huge mistake and Mathias Fernandez-Pardo (Lille) has an easy task to put the ball into the back of the net. 1:1.

74' Close effort! Mitchel Bakker (Lille) takes the resulting free kick from a promising distance, but he sends it narrowly wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Marseille.
73' The referee gives a yellow card to Ulisses Garcia (Marseille).
72' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Mitchel Bakker (Lille) comes onto the pitch so that Hakon Arnar Haraldsson can be given a rest.
69' Gabriel Gudmundsson (Lille) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Geronimo Rulli intercepts the ball.
66' Bruno Genesio decides to make a substitution. Nabil Bentaleb will be replaced by Ngalayel Mukau (Lille).
65' It's time for a substitution. That's the last involvement from Ismaily as he is replaced by Gabriel Gudmundsson (Lille).
65' Ismaily (Lille) picks up a yellow card for an infringement.
63' Mason Greenwood (Marseille) shows off his individual ability with a jinking run into the box. Unfortunately, the finish lets him down as the ball flies high over the bar.
61' It looks like Pierre-Emile Hojbjerg (Marseille) saw red with that tackle. Eric Wattellier won't tolerate such behaviour on the pitch and blows for a foul.
57' 0 - 1 Goal - 0:1! Adrien Rabiot laid the ball off to Amine Gouiri (Marseille), who shot from close range into the bottom right corner, leaving the goalkeeper helpless.
56' Nothing comes of the resulting corner from Hakon Arnar Haraldsson (Lille). The defence is alert and manages to cut it out.

55' Benjamin Andre (Lille) is first to react to a whipped in corner and flashes a header in on goal from close range, but one of his teammates inadvertently blocks the ball and stops him scoring. No wonder he's upset! The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Lille.
55' Hakon Arnar Haraldsson (Lille) will try to find the head of one of his teammates from a corner kick.
54' Jonathan David (Lille) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Lille.
52' A goal, which was scored by Jonathan David (Lille), was disallowed due to offside.

51' Adrien Rabiot (Marseille) latches on to a precise pass and one-on-one with the keeper slams the ball towards the right-hand post. Lucas Chevalier is alert, though, and leaps like a salmon to deny him.
49' The defence is alert as they clear a dangerous cross from Benjamin Andre (Lille).
46' Bruno Genesio makes a half-time substitution. Osame Sahraoui (Lille) comes on in place of Chuba Akpom.
46' Half-time substitution. Ismael Bennacer is replaced by Valentin Rongier (Marseille).
46' Eric Wattellier blows his whistle and the second half starts.
45+2' That is it for the first half after the referee blows his whistle and the players head to their respective dressing rooms.
45+1' Thomas Meunier (Lille) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Geronimo Rulli, who smothers the ball.
45' We will have 1 min. of added time.
45' Eric Wattellier blows for a foul after Ismaily (Lille) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball.
44' Ismael Bennacer (Marseille) takes the corner kick and sends the ball among a huddle of players inside the penalty area, but one of the defenders clears it to safety.

44' Mason Greenwood (Marseille) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack. The referee blows his whistle, Marseille are awarded a corner kick.

42' Geoffrey Kondogbia (Marseille) is obviously not following the Golden Rule: "Treat others as you want to be treated.“ He makes a bad challenge and leaves Eric Wattellier with no other option than to blow for a foul.
39' Chuba Akpom (Lille) gives away a foul for a clumsy challenge. Referee Eric Wattellier saw the whole situation.
38' The foul by Jonathan David (Lille) was seen by Eric Wattellier who didn't hesitate to blow the whistle.
36' Amine Gouiri (Marseille) swings in the corner, but it's comfortably cleared away.
34' Lucas Chevalier pulls off a great save to deny Michael Murillo (Marseille), who makes himself some space inside the box and unleashes a quick shot towards the middle of the goal.
33' Mason Greenwood (Marseille) sends a cross into the box, but Lucas Chevalier comes off his line to gather the ball.
31' Nabil Bentaleb (Lille) takes a mid-range free kick and the effort crashes into the defensive wall.
29' Ismael Bennacer (Marseille) receives a yellow card for a nasty tackle.
27' Mason Greenwood (Marseille) did his best to latch on to a crossfield pass, but it was too long and it goes out of play. The ball is out of play. Lille will have a throw-in.
23' Marseille control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.
20' 38:62 – the latest ball possession ratio.
17' It's a throw-in for Lille.
13' Pierre-Emile Hojbjerg (Marseille) trips an opposition player and Eric Wattellier signals a foul.
12' A dangerous looking corner kick from Amine Gouiri (Marseille) is cleared to safety by the defence.

11' Mason Greenwood (Marseille) sends a lofted cross into the penalty area. Unfortunately for him, the opponent's defence deals with his cross comfortably and intercepts it. Good work from Marseille as they win a corner.
8' Eric Wattellier blows his whistle for a foul after Hakon Arnar Haraldsson (Lille) hacks down one of his opponents.

6' Pierre-Emile Hojbjerg (Marseille) controls a neat pass and has options, but decides to shoot from distance. The ball flies low towards the middle of the net, but Lucas Chevalier is well positioned to make a comfortable save.
4' Marseille seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
The players are on the pitch and Marseille will have the kick-off.
Eric Wattellier will supervise the game today.
